limitations.text: No warehouse inventory could be produced: no labelled training examples for this AOI, zero-shot text retrieval not configured, linear_probe has no examples, and both GSI aerial and Sentinel-2 imagery scene ids returned 'this task has no imagery source'. Only aef-10m-annual index at 160 m cells (synthetic fixture, 3430 cells) was built; it cannot be verified against buildings. Area searched: none reviewed; AOI about 9.1 km x 7.8 km.

understanding.goal_restated: Find every warehouse (large logistics/storage building, roughly 1,600 m2+ floor area) in the AOI lon 136.82-136.92, lat 35.05-35.12 (Japan), returning point locations inside each building with evidence, confidence, and a count with range. Exclude factories, markets, hangars, other large roofs.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings coarse for 40 m+ buildings
understanding.scope: AOI bbox ~10km x 8km. Embedding candidates then GSI aerial verification.
